findings.surface: DeleteStack/rollback teardown ordering for custom resources
findings.claim: When a custom resource is deleted, the emulator sends the provider's Delete and immediately records DELETE_COMPLETE while the provider's answer is outstanding; the provider function and the resources it acts on must survive until that answer. AWS deletes in reverse dependency order and completes the custom resource only after the provider responds. PARTIALLY VERIFIED: current code defers dependency teardown via still_needed, so the doc's 'dependencies deleted in the same pass' half is UNVERIFIED here; the premature DELETE_COMPLETE record is confirmed.
findings.root_cause: /Users/dylanwong/projects/aws0-2026-11-19/aws0/services/service-com-amazonaws-cloudformation-cloudformation/src/state/provisioning.rs:4446-4485 sends the Delete; :4487-4539 pushes a Stabilising wait with provider_request (:4514-4523) and extends still_needed with needed_by (:4524-4531), but also sets materialised=false (:4533) and records a finished DELETE_COMPLETE (:4535-4539) immediately; delete_pass :4329-4339 skips still_needed resources on later indices; /Users/dylanwong/projects/aws0-2026-11-19/aws0/services/service-com-amazonaws-cloudformation-cloudformation/src/state/provisioning/outstanding_teardown.rs:71-141 resumes only after the wait; /Users/dylanwong/projects/aws0-2026-11-19/aws0/services/service-com-amazonaws-cloudformation-cloudformation/src/ops/delete_stack.rs:614-633 turns a residual failure into DELETE_FAILED.
